package.name: tactile_msgs
package.description: New ROS2 interfaces for the tactile sensor system that do not already exist in the legacy repo. Raw tactile voltage messages (Tactile, TactileStamped) and the bias-computation action are intentionally NOT redefined here -- they already exist and work in uclv_tactile_interfaces; reuse that package for those. This package only adds CalibrationStatus and TactileProcessed.
